# comfyops-mcp - Full Documentation

## Overview

comfyops-mcp wraps ComfyUI as a managed sidecar and exposes its generation
capabilities as FastMCP portmanteau tools. No need to touch ComfyUI's node
editor - pick a curated workflow, give a prompt, get a PNG/MP4.

## Architecture

```
comfyops-mcp (FastMCP 3.4+, HTTP :11087 + stdio)
  |-- comfy_generate     - submit workflow JSON, VRAM guard, poll result
  |-- comfy_workflows    - curated workflow depot (27 JSONs)
  |-- comfy_models       - list installed models, HF downloads, VRAM, health
  |-- comfy_library      - SQLite generation history (gallery data)
  |-- comfy_agentic_assist - SEP-1577 sampling workflow
  |-- Starlette REST     - /api/health, /api/models, /api/gallery*, /api/generate,
  |                        /api/workflows, /api/prompt*, /api/nodes*
  '-- ComfyUI sidecar    - managed child process on :11086 (own venv python)
```

## Tools

### comfy_generate
Portmanteau with operations: image, video, upscale, inpaint, edit.
Parameters: workflow_id, prompt, seed (optional), size (optional),
negative_prompt (optional), image_input (base64, for i2v/inpaint).
Returns: prompt_id, outputs (filenames), seed, message.
Validates the workflow exists BEFORE the VRAM check, and frees VRAM
(POST /free) after each completed run so the next guard reads honestly.

### comfy_workflows
Portmanteau with operations: list, get, validate, register.
Workflows are curated JSON files in `workflows/*.json` with `_meta` metadata.
Verified: flux2-klein-t2i (FLUX.2 klein 4B fp8, seed-reproducible), sd15-t2i.

### comfy_models
Portmanteau with operations: list_installed, download, check_vram, health.
- list_installed scans MODELS_DIR (default D:\ComfyUI\models) recursively.
- download streams from Hugging Face (`hf_repo`/`filename` into an allowlisted
  subdir), verifies sha256 when provided, honors `dest_name` for renames, and
  sends `Authorization: Bearer` when COMFYOPS_HF_TOKEN is set (gated repos).
  Reports verification state honestly (UNVERIFIED when no sha256 given).
- check_vram consults ComfyUI /system_stats; health returns version + VRAM.

### comfy_library
Portmanteau with operations: recent, search, record.
Uses SQLite3 at data/library.sqlite3.

### comfy_agentic_assist
Takes a natural language goal, uses ctx.sample() to plan generation.
Requires a host that supports MCP sampling.

## REST Gallery API (webapp)

| Endpoint | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| GET /api/gallery | filtered/sorted/paginated list - workflow_id, model, q, date_from, date_to, sort (date_desc/date_asc/prompt/seed/workflow/model), limit/offset, has_more |
| POST /api/gallery/delete | batch delete {prompt_ids: []} - records only, files kept |
| GET /api/gallery/export?format=csv\|json | export the filtered set (CSV = attachment) |
| GET /api/gallery/{prompt_id}/related | crossconnects: same workflow/model generations |

## VRAM Management

The 24 GB RTX 4090 is shared with Ollama and LM Studio. vram_guard checks
free VRAM before queueing (per-workflow estimates in _MODEL_VRAM_MAP).
Verified requirements:
- FLUX.2 klein (fp8 compute): ~8 GB (unet 3.9 GB + qwen_3_4b encoder 7.5 GB + VAE)
- SD 1.5: ~2.5 GB
Curated estimates: FLUX.1 family 12 GB, SDXL 7 GB, Wan t2v 20 GB, ESRGAN 2 GB.

## Env Vars (repo-root .env - single source of truth)

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| COMFYOPS_COMFYUI_HOST | 127.0.0.1 | ComfyUI host |
| COMFYOPS_COMFYUI_PORT | 11086 | ComfyUI port |
| COMFYOPS_COMFYUI_DIR | D:\ComfyUI | ComfyUI installation dir |
| COMFYOPS_COMFYUI_PYTHON | (auto) | ComfyUI venv python for the sidecar |
| COMFYOPS_MODELS_DIR | D:\ComfyUI\models | Model file location (must be ComfyUI's tree) |
| COMFYOPS_HF_TOKEN | (empty) | Hugging Face token for gated model downloads |
| COMFYOPS_TIMEOUT | 900 | Generation timeout in seconds |
| COMFYOPS_WORKFLOWS_DIR | ./workflows | Curated workflow depot |
| COMFYOPS_OLLAMA_URL | http://127.0.0.1:11434 | Prompt refinement LLM |
| COMFYOPS_LLM_MODEL | (varies) | Ollama model for prompt refinement |
| PORT | 11087 | Backend FastMCP/REST port |
| COMFYOPS_FRONTEND_PORT | 11088 | Vite dev port |

## Prerequisites

- Python 3.11+, uv, Node.js 18+ (webapp)
- ComfyUI at COMFYOPS_COMFYUI_DIR - updated 0.33+ (git pull + `pip install -r
  requirements.txt` + torch 2.11 cu128 from the pytorch index); the sidecar uses
  ComfyUI's OWN venv python (never comfyops' - no torch there)
- Verified model set for PNG gen (~11.7 GB): flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors
  (diffusion_models), qwen_3_4b.safetensors (text_encoders), flux2-vae.safetensors
  (vae) - see models_manifest.yaml for sha256s
